messages:
Ava Chen: Anyone up for an office fantasy football playoff pick'em? Bracket style, $10 buy-in. Winner gets a $50 Amazon gift card and infinite bragging rights. Polling to set roster freeze: Fri 5pm. Reply with 👍 if in.
Miguel Torres: I'm in. Count me. Also can we do an office potluck for the final? :pizza: :beer:
Samir Patel: In as well. Quick Q — are we using FAAB for waivers or straight first-come?
Ava Chen: Going simple: first-come waivers. Keep it light.
Lena Brooks: I'll join, but only if we can have vegetarian options at the potluck. Also, @Ava can you DM Venmo?
Miguel Torres: Venmo is fine. I'll bring nachos (veg-friendly).
DeployBot: Reminder: payment deadline set for 2026-03-05 17:00 UTC. Ping me when you pay and I'll mark you as paid. :robot_face:
Samir Patel: Paid. TXN# 4532 (venmo).
Ava Chen: Noted Samir, thanks. Miguel, Lena — if you want me to collect I can share a payments spreadsheet.
Lena Brooks: Paid.
Miguel Torres: Paid. Also i predict Samir's squad will bust out early but maybe that's just bias. :laughing:
Ava Chen: Haha we'll see. Bracket lock Fri 5pm. Please set your lineup and let DeployBot know when you're paid.
Miguel Torres: Can we put a small trophy in the office? Cheap plastic one, engraved?
Lena Brooks: Yes please.
Ava Chen: Will ask office-ops.
DeployBot: Current paid count: 3/4. Next reminder in 48 hours.
Samir Patel: Also, side bet: worst record has to buy coffee for the team for a week.
Ava Chen: Added to the rules thread — winner gets gift card + trophy; last place buys coffee. Agreed?
All: 👍
Miguel Torres: Also can we do a small charity donation option instead of gift card? like winner picks charity and we donate $20?
Ava Chen: Good idea — will add as optional.
Lena Brooks: Love that.
Ava Chen: Ok folks. Final checklist: pay by Fri 5pm, set lineup, potluck signups (veg options noted), trophy ask to office-ops. See you in the playoffs! :football:
